notes.title: Bug Fixes Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
I’ve just rolled out a new update for BOTANICAL CHRONICLE that addresses a few bugs reported by you, our awesome players. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify and squash these issues, making the game experience smoother and more enjoyable.

Thank you all for your support and for playing the game! We’re committed to keeping BOTANICAL CHRONICLE the best it can be, so keep those reports coming and enjoy the improved version.
Happy exploring!
